title: Conveyor classification and safe jam
summary: Walk through part classification and the safe jam lockout in the Conveyor 01 example.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Stop the belt and light FaultLamp while the plant reports JamDetected.
Keep Reset from releasing the fault while the jam is still present.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Conveyor.st, keep Requested and MetalLatched and add Faulted; the sensors belong to the plant.
stages.checkpoint: The logic commands outputs only from plant-recorded sensors.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict the belt, diverter, and fault lamp.
stages.checkpoint: Belt ON {{t:10}}–{{t:40}}; Diverter ON only {{t:30}}; FaultLamp ON and Belt OFF {{t:50}}–{{t:80}}. Reset at {{t:60}} does not release while JamDetected remains active.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter misses the deterministic jam lockout; stop the belt and light FaultLamp while the plant reports JamDetected, and do not let Reset release it while the jam remains.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson and lists every assertion that failed.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named Conveyor01 and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Review the matrix: classifier+metal {{t:20}}, diverter+count=1 at {{t:30}}, jam {{t:50}}.
stages.checkpoint: The jam turns FaultLamp on and stops Belt.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The NEVER assertion covers DiverterCommand ON with BeltCommand OFF only in this scenario.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: A jam must win over everything else: when JamDetected is TRUE, latch a Faulted memory and drop the belt request, so the belt stays stopped even after the jam input goes away.
Compute BeltCommand as Requested AND NOT Faulted, FaultLamp as Faulted OR JamDetected, and clear Faulted with Reset only when JamDetected is FALSE.

faultCases: The starter misses the deterministic jam lockout; stop the belt and light FaultLamp while the plant reports JamDetected, and do not let Reset release it while the jam remains.
